MAROWAK_ALOLAN.reason: Physical Fire/Ghost, Rock Head, boosting and coverage already work. Older-game recovery supports a different bulky build.

RAPIDASH_GALARIAN.reason: Custom Fairy/Fire physical attacks, Morning Sun and Agility already work. Physical boosting and Electric coverage are optional.

SLOWKING_GALARIAN.reason: Both special boosts, recovery, Trick Room and coverage already give many builds. Hazards are optional support.

ARCANINE_HISUIAN.reason: Already has Morning Sun, Rock Head dual recoil STAB, priority and Close Combat. Electric coverage is optional.

TYPHLOSION_HISUIAN.reason: Calm Mind, dual special STAB, burns and Infernal Parade already work. Fighting coverage is optional.

SNEASLER.reason: Technician, priority, Swords Dance/Bulk Up and physical STAB already provide varied offense. Pivoting is optional.

CLODSIRE.reason: Unaware/Recover, Haze and both Spikes types already form a useful pool. These are optional team-support alternatives.

TAUROS_PALDEAN_FIRE.reason: Intimidate, Bulk Up, strong dual STAB and coverage already work. Electric coverage is an optional Water matchup tool.

TAUROS_PALDEAN_WATER.reason: Intimidate, Bulk Up, strong dual STAB and coverage already work. Electric coverage is an optional Water matchup tool.

AGGRON.reason: Rock Head Head Smash and Iron Defense/Body Press plus hazards already offer several builds. Speed support is optional.

KLEAVOR.reason: Sharpness Stone Axe, Swords Dance, Knock Off and hazards already establish roles. Pivot/Fighting coverage are optional.

GLIMMORA.reason: Hazards, removal, Toxic Debris and strong special Rock/Poison/Ground coverage already work. Grass coverage is optional.

TOXAPEX.reason: Regenerator/Recover, Haze, Knock Off and hazards already make a complete wall. Older-game Scald is optional and a substantial buff, not needed to rescue the pool.

ZANGOOSE.reason: Scrappy/Sharpness, strong Normal attacks, Swords Dance/Belly Drum and Fighting coverage already work. Another physical coverage option is optional.

SEVIPER.reason: Swords Dance, custom Dark STAB, strong Poison attacks and Flamethrower already work. Ice Fang is physical coverage; Dark Pulse is a mixed variant.

ARCHEOPS.reason: Custom abilities remove Defeatist; it already has U-turn, hazards, removal and strong attacks. Older-game recovery is an optional substantial buff.

CARRACOSTA.reason: Shell Smash, Swift Swim, priority, strong dual STAB and Body Press/Iron Defense already provide variety. Immediate Fighting power is optional.

MAWILE.reason: Huge Power, Swords Dance, priority and extensive coverage already give strong offense. Disruption is a useful but optional alternate role.

ESPATHRA.reason: Speed Boost, Calm Mind, Lumina Crash, Roost and special coverage already work. Pivoting is optional; this mon already has a complete win condition.

PALAFIN.reason: Custom Fighting typing/abilities, priority, Flip Turn, boosts and broad physical attacks already make a rich pool. Disruption is optional.

GOROCHU.reason: Its mixed Electric/Dark pool is already healthy, but Nasty Plot currently has only 55-power Snarl for special Dark STAB. Dark Pulse would complete that alternate build. This is a deliberate custom-typing addition, not official Raichu/Gorochu learnability.

VILEPLUME.reason: Sleep Powder, Synthesis/Moonlight, Giga Drain, Earth Power, Moonblast, Sludge Bomb and Swords Dance already support distinct bulky, sun and mixed variants. Keep its current pool.

DITTO.reason: Keep Transform. Imposter supplies the opponent's moves; normal learnset size does not measure its variety.

WOBBUFFET.reason: Keep the counter/trapper identity. Counter, Mirror Coat, Encore and Destiny Bond already create a coherent four-move build; more coverage would change the concept.

SMEARGLE.reason: Sketch is its distribution mechanism. The listed pool count excludes copied moves and should not be interpreted as a poor movepool.

MESMERIA.reason: Custom Jynx evolution already has Calm Mind, Nasty Plot, Freeze-Dry, Psychic, Lovely Kiss via the family tutor, Shadow Ball and Wish. No broad rescue buff needed.

GOROTORA.reason: Custom mixed Electric/Normal has both STAB categories, ExtremeSpeed, coverage, Agility and Volt Tackle through its family tutor. The current options are already healthy.

UNOWN.reason: The only genuinely tiny conventional offensive pool: four total accessible moves despite 108 Attack and 108 Sp. Atk. If all mons must offer multiple builds, deliberately expand its psychic-symbol theme with setup and Ghost coverage. Both additions are custom design, not official Unown learnability.

SCYTHER.reason: Scyther is a distinct fast physical attacker/Eviolite option, not merely an incomplete Scizor. Pivoting and recovery give it an independent role.

CHANSEY.reason: Eviolite cleric already has Softboiled, Wish and Seismic Toss. Speed control/hazards are natural team-support alternatives.

PORYGON2.reason: Recover, Trick Room and BoltBeam already give an Eviolite tank. Foul Play punishes physical setup; Shadow Ball is an optional attacking alternative.

DUSCLOPS.reason: Eviolite plus Pain Split/Will-O-Wisp already works. Prankster and slow speed justify more deliberate team support.

CORSOLA_GALARIAN.reason: Already has Eviolite, recovery, hazards and status. A special defensive boost is an optional alternate build.

RAICHU.reason: Regular Raichu remains a distinct 110-speed mixed attacker before the custom Gorochu evolution. Volt Switch supplies the missing pivot; Focus Blast is an optional special coverage build.

JYNX.reason: Lovely Kiss, special STAB, both special boosts and Wish already give distinct builds. Fighting coverage and disruption are useful alternatives before Mesmeria; an eventual inheritance fix should preserve these on the custom evolution.

MURKROW.reason: Eviolite/Prankster, Taunt and Haze already work. Immediate recovery and priority speed control provide a clear independent support role before Honchkrow.

GIRAFARIG.reason: Already has Contrary, both special boosts, Baton Pass and coverage. Slow-team support or healing offers alternatives; its evolution should retain family support access.

STANTLER.reason: Its stronger Attack, Intimidate and screens already offer a physical support role. Electric coverage and slow-team support are optional alternatives.

PILOSWINE.reason: Eviolite, Thick Fat, Ice Shard and dual physical STAB already work. Hazards add a distinct bulky lead role.

CHARJABUG.reason: This stage has much lower Sp. Atk than Vikavolt, but good Eviolite defenses and a slow speed. Webs and a slow pivot provide support; Wild Charge opens a physical Hustle/Agility build using its stronger Attack and existing X-Scissor.

DURALUDON.reason: Already has Body Press/Iron Defense and special Steel/Dragon attacks. Immediate Dragon power and speed support give useful Eviolite alternatives.

MAGNETON.reason: Already has dual special STAB, Volt Switch and screens; its 70 speed distinguishes it from Magnezone. Generic Substitute access is optional.

TOGETIC.reason: Eviolite, Soft-Boiled, Calm Mind and Fairy/Fighting special attacks already give a distinct slow tank. Speed control and Hyper Voice for its custom Pixilate ability broaden support/offense; it already has immediate recovery.

ONIX.reason: Custom 75 Attack/80 speed, Rock Head, Eviolite defenses and Body Press/Iron Defense already make it independently useful. Modern egg Head Smash offers an optional Rock Head attacker alongside its existing Double-Edge.

GLIGAR.reason: Eviolite, Immunity, Swords Dance and U-turn already give an independent pivot. Recovery and removal offer a natural defensive alternative; both have Gen 8 BDSP precedent; they are not Gen 9 claims.

RHYDON.reason: Eviolite, 130 Attack, strong STAB and coverage already work. Immediate physical setup or defense-based damage offer optional alternatives before Rhyperior.

ELECTABUZZ.reason: 105 speed and Eviolite distinguish it from Electivire. A special pivot and Fighting coverage fit its 95 Sp. Atk; existing Iron Fist punches support a separate physical/mixed option.

MAGMAR.reason: Its balanced 95 Attack/100 Sp. Atk and Eviolite permit different builds. Modern egg Belly Drum plus Mach Punch gives a real physical alternative to special Fire offense; these belong in the Magby family list if selected.
